senses.gloss: परम- + अणु परम- + अणु, m. an atom.
पर्याय- + अन्न पर्याय- + अन्न, n. food prepared for another.
पर- + अर्थ पर- + अर्थ, m. 1. great importance. 2. the interests of another. 3. sexual intercourse.
परम- + अर्थ परम- + अर्थ, m. 1. the most sublime truth. 2. the whole truth. 3. reality. 4. earnest, Śāk. d. 51.
परि- + आकुल परि- + आकुल, adj. 1. full of. 2. confused. 3. agitated.
परम- + आत्मन् परम- + आत्मन्, m. the universal soul.
परम- + आनन्द परम- + आनन्द, m. 1. the highest bliss. 2. the universal soul.
परि-मित- + आयुस् परि-मित- + आयुस् (vb. मा), adj. short-lived, Rām. 3, 55, 20.
परि- + आविल परि- + आविल, adj. very turbid, Ragh. 7, 37.
पर- + आश्रय पर- + आश्रय, m. 1. dependence from another, Hariv. 5154. 2. the refuge of the enemies, Bhāg. P. 1, 4, 12.
परुष- + इतर परुष- + इतर, adj. mild, Ragh. 5, 68.
परि- + उत्सुक परि- + उत्सुक, adj. 1. longing for. 2. languid. 3. sad.
पर- + उपकारिन् पर- + उपकारिन्, adj. supporting others.
पर्व(न्)- + काल पर्व(न्)- + काल, m. the periodic change of the moon.
पर्ण- + कुटी पर्ण- + कुटी, f. a hut made of leaves, Rām. 2, 92, 12.
पर्ण- + कृच्छ्र पर्ण- + कृच्छ्र, m. a kind of penance.
परि- + गर्वित परि- + गर्वित, adj. very proud, Cāṇ. 94 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 413.
पर्व(न्)- and विष्णु- + गुप्त पर्व(न्)- and विष्णु- + गुप्त, m. proper names.
पार्ष्णि- + ग्राह पार्ष्णि- + ग्राह, m. a supporting prince (perhaps, rather, a dangerous prince), Man. 7, 207.

पार्ष्णिग्राह पार्ष्णि-ग्राह, m. An enemy in the rear, Man. 7, 207.
 --Comp.

पार्ष्णिग्रह पार्ष्णि-ग्रह, adj. Seizing from behind, Bhāg. P. 8, 2, 27.
 --Comp.
पर- + चक्र पर- + चक्र, n. the host of the enemy, MBh. 1, 6209.
पर- + छन्द पर- + छन्द, m. dependence, Bhāg. P. 3, 31, 25.
पर-तन्त्र पर-तन्त्र, adj. dependent upon another, MBh. 13, 15.
पार- + दर्शक पार- + दर्शक, adj. showing the opposite bank or shore, Bhāg. P. 1, 13, 38.
पार- + दर्शन पार- + दर्शन, adj. seeing the opposite bank or shore, Bhāg. P. 9, 4, 58.
परिदीन परिदीन, much afflicted.
पर- + देवता पर- + देवता, f. the supreme deity. []
पर- + देश पर- + देश, m. a foreign country.
पार- + ध्वज पार- + ध्वज, m. pl. standards come from an opposite shore (i. e. from Ceylon), Rājat. 3, 78.
परि- + निर्वृति परि- + निर्वृति, f. complete liberation of the soul from the body and exemption from future transmigration.

परि- + नेत्र परि- + नेत्र,
 I. m. an owl.
 II. n. the white lotus.

पर पर, i. e. perhaps अप + र, or 1. पृ + अ,
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Distant.
 2. Opposite, ulterior, Rām. 1, 11, 19 Gorr.
 3. Being beyond, Man. 7, 158.
 4. Exceeding, MBh. 1, 7975; left or remaining, Kathās. 39, 16.
 5. Highest, longest, Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 12.
 6. Ancient, Man. 9, 99.
 7. Pre-eminent, superior, higher, Man. 2, 83.
 8. Distinguished, greatest, Man. 1, 106.
 9. Intent, Rām. 5, 24, 13.
 10. Subsequent, following, Man. 3, 37.
 11. Different, Prab. 114, 8; other, Rām. 6, 9, 12.
 12. Inimical, enemy, Man. 7, 94.
 II. परम्, adv.
 1. With abl.,
 a. Beyond, Ragh. 1, 17.
 b. After, Man. 2, 122.
 2. With preceding अतस्,
 a. Further from hence, Nal. 9, 23.
 b. After that, Man. 8, 129.
 c. Next, 9, 56.
 3. Excessively, Rām. 6, 5, 14.
 4. Completely, Mālav. 4, 19. []
 5. Rather, MBh. 13, 4857.
 6. Most willingly, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 406.
 7. At the most, 993.
 8. With preceding यदि, Perhaps, Kathās. 42, 19.
 9. Only, 40, 8.
 10. But, Pañc. 243, 14.
 III. परेण,
 1. with acc. Beyond; परेणास्मान् परैहि, Pass by us, MBh. 1, 8414.
 2. Afterwards, Man. 8, 30.
 3. With abl. After, MBh. 12, 842.
 IV. परे, adv. Afterwards, 12, 2880.
 V. m. and n. The universal soul, Bhag. 3, 19.
 VI. n. Culmen, highest degree, MBh. 1, 2025.
 VII. m.
 1. A descendant, Pañc. iii. d. 216.
 2. A proper name.
 3. The name of the palace of Mitravindā, Hariv. 8986.
 VIII. f. रा, The name of a river.
 IX. When latter part of a comp. it implies often,
 1. Intent on, e. g. शौच-, adj. Intent on purity, Man. 3, 192.
 2. Absorbed in, e. g. चिन्ता-, adj. Thoughtful.
 3. Affected with, e. g. करुणा-, adj. Compassionate.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πέραν, πέρην, πέρα, πέρηθεν, περαίτερος, etc., περαῖος, πέρας, πεῖρας, ἄπειρος, ἀπείρεσιος, etc.; Lat. perendie, i. e. pere-m + die; see also पृ.

परा परा, old instr. sing. of पर, inseparable preposition combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives (immediately with a noun in परासु), Away, over, on, inverted, wrong, back, sideward.
 --Cf. παρά, πάλιν; [] Lat. per, e. g. in per-dere, per-fidus (cf. परि); Goth. fair- and fra-; A.S. for.

पार पार, i. e. 1. पृ + अ,
 I. m. and n. The further or opposite bank of a river or sea, Rām. 3, 54, 14; figuratively with gen. The totality of the object denoted by the gen., e. g. तमसस्, The whole darkness, Chr. 294, 6 = Rigv. i. 92, 6. कारणानाम्, All the tortures, Daśak. in Chr. 195, 16.
 2. End, Yājñ. 1, 51.
 II. m. Quicksilver.
 --Comp.

परकीय परकीय, i. e. पर + क + ईय, adj.
 1. Belonging to another, Śāk. d. 97.
 2. Hostile, Kām. Nītis. 8, 70.
परज पर-ज, m. A stranger.

परतस् पर + तस्, adv.
 1. = abl. of पर, e. g. परतस्-परस्, Higher than the highest, Kumāras. 2, 14; स्वकात् परतो वा गेहात्, From his own house or that of another, Bhāg. P. 1, 13, 25.
 2. Further, Rām. 2, 15, 5 Gorr.
 3. With abl.
 a. After, Yājñ. 2, 173.
 b. Over, Bhag. 3, 42.

परता पर + ता, f.
 1. Absoluteness, Bhāṣāp. 7.
 2. Highest degree, Rājat. 5, 377.
 --Comp.
पारत पारत (cf. पार), m. Quicksilver, Kathās. 37, 232.
परत्र पर + त्र, adv. In the other world, Man. 3, 275. परत्राय पर-त्राय, To the other world, MBh. 13, 7688.

परत्व पर + त्व, n.
 1. Condition of being more extensive (as a genus), Bhāṣāp. 7; comprehensive.
 2. Length of distance and time, Bhāṣāp. 120.
परदारिन् परदारिन्, i. e. पर-दार + इन्, m. An adulterer, Rām. 3, 57, 20.
परंतप परंतप, i. e. पर + म्-तप् + अ, adj. subst. Vexing the foe, Bhag. 4, 2. A conqueror.
परपुष्ट पर-पुष्ट (vb. पुष्), m. The Cocila or Indian cuckoo, Rām. 3, 78, 29. f. टा, Its female.
परभागता पर-भाग + ता, f. Excellence, supremacy, Ragh. 5, 70.
परभृत पर-भृत (vb. भृ), m. The Cocila or Indian cuckoo, Śāk. d. 85.

परम पर + म,
 I. superl. of पर, f. मा.
 1. Most excellent, Man. 1, 108; best, 4, 14.
 2. Highest, Man. 9, 319.
 3. Extreme, 8, 302.
 4. Worst, Brāhmaṇav. 1, 15.
 5. With चेतस्, All (the heart), Rām. 2, 34, 36.
 6. With an abl. it has the signification of the comparat., More excellent, superior, worse; को न्यो स्ति परमः शिवात्, Who is higher than Śiva, MBh. 13, 793.
 II. परमम्, adv. Yes, MBh. 3, 17056. Very well, Johns. Sel. 37, 20.
 III. When latter part of a comp. adj. it implies sometimes,
 1. Amounting at the most to, MBh. 2, 2080.
 2. Consisting principally of, 5, 1143.
 3. Occupied only with, Man. 6, 96.

परमक परम + क, adj., f. इका,
 1. Most excellent, best, Rām. 4, 35, 13.
 2. Highest, MBh. 3, 13695.
 3. Extreme, Chr. 35, 12.
परमतस् परम + तस्, adv. Still worse, Bhartṛ. 3, 6.

परमाणुता परमाणुता, i. e. परम-अणु + ता, f.
 1. The condition of an atom, Ragh. 15, 22.
 2. An infinitely short moment, Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 4.
परमार्थतस् परमार्थतस्, i. e. परम-अर्थ + तस्, adv. In the true sense of the word, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 19; Pañc. i. d. 152.

परमेष्ठिन् परमेष्ठिन्, i. e. परम + इ-स्थिन् (vb. स्था),
 1. m. The supreme being, a name of Brahman, Śiva, etc.
 2. m. A proper name.

परंपर परंपर, i. e. पर + म्-पर,
 I. adj. Successive, one after another, Suśr. 1, 105, 3.
 II. f. रा,
 1. An uninterrupted succession, a chain, Pañc. 251, 9.
 2. A continuous lineage, MBh. 3, 13621.
 --Comp.
परवत् पर + वत्, adv. Like a stranger, Kathās. 27, 185.
परवत्ता परवत्ता, i. e. परवन्त् + ता, f. Obedience, Vikr. d. 155.

पारावत पारावत, m.
 1. See पारापत.
 2. A kind of snake.
 3. A tree, Diospyros embryopteris Pers. (n. its fruit).
 4. pl. A class of deities.

परवन्त् पर + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Depending on another, Śāk. d. 53.
 2. Deprived of strength, Utt. Rāmac. 80, 11.
 3. Ready to obey, MBh. 13, 2731.
 --Comp.
परवश्यता पर-वश्य + ता, f. Dependence on another, Rām. 5, 26, 18.
परवाच्यता पर-वाच्य + ता (vb. वच्), f. Condition of being an object of censure to others, MBh. 6, 4476.

परशु परशु, i. e. पर-, compounded with a derivative of शो, m. An axe, a hatchet, Rām. 1, 74, 18.
 --Cf. πέλεκυς.

परासु परासु, i. e. परा-असु, adj.
 1. Dying, Suśr. 1, 114, 15.
 2. Dead, MBh. 1, 3835.
परश्वध परश्वध (cf. the last), m. An axe, a hatchet, Rām. 6, 27, 25.
परश्वधिन् परश्वधिन्, i. e. पर-श्वध + इन्, adj. Provided with an axe, MBh. 5, 6099.

परस् परस् (akin to पर), adv. and prep.
 1. Beyond.
 2. After.
 3. More than.
 4. Without.
 --Comp.
परोरजस् परोरजस्, i. e. परस्-रजस्, adj. untouched by passion, Utt. Rāmac. 120, 10.
परोरजस् परोरजस्, see s. v. परस्.
परसात् पर + सात्, adv. Into the hands of another, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 931.

परस्तात् परस्-तात् (old abl. of तद्), adv. and prep. with the gen.
 1. Beyond, Bhag. 8, 9.
 2. Higher, Mālav. d. 1.
 3. Further on.
 4. Afterward, Bhāg. P. 4, 9, 20.

परस्पर पर + स्-पर,
 I. adj. (sing. and without nom. sing.),
 1. Each other, mutual, Bhag. 3, 11.
 2. One with another, MBh. 12, 2420 (nom. pl.).
 II. रम्, adv.
 1. Each other, mutually, Man. 9, 62.
 2. To one after another, Bhāg. P. 1, 8, 9.
परस्परतस् परस्पर + तस्, adv. One by another, mutually, Nal. 5, 34.
पराक पराक, i. e. पराञ्च् + अ, m. A sort of penance, fasting for twelve days and nights, Man. 11, 215.

पराक्रम परा-क्रम् + अ, m.
 1. Prowess, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 498.
 2. Exertion, Rām. 6, 37, 49.
 3. Strength, valour, Man. 7, 11.
 4. Power, Rām. 1, 75, 17.
पराक्रमवन्त् पराक्रम + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Endowed with courage, or power, Mārk. P. 21, 92.
पराक्रमिन् पराक्रमिन्, i. e. परा-क्रम् + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Exerting one's power, MBh. 6, 1915.
पराक्रान्तृ पराक्रान्तृ, i. e. परा-क्रम् + तृ, m. Exerting one's power, MBh. 6, 1945.
पराग पराग, i. e. probably उप or अप-राग, m. The pollen or farina of a flower, Bhartṛ. 1, 39.

पारग पार-ग, adj.
 1. Crossing MBh. 2, 2418.
 2. Intending to cross, 4, 451.
 3. Accomplishing, Rām. 3, 53, 8.
 4. Having studied, knowing, Pañc. 155, 4.
 --Comp.
पराङ्मुखता पराङ्मुखता, i. e. पराञ्च्-मुख + ता, f. Condition of having averted one's face, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 530.
पराङ्मुखत्व पराङ्मुखत्व, i. e. पराञ्च्-मुख + त्व, n. The same figuratively, Aversion, Ragh. 18, 13.

पराचीन पराचीन, i. e. पराञ्च् + ईन, adj.
 1. Turned away, Suśr. 1, 100, 12.
 2. Not minding, MBh. 12, 8159.
 3. Being beyond, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 30.

पराजय पराजय, i. e. परा-जि + अ, m.
 1. Being deprived of, loss (with abl.), MBh. 3, 2565.
 2. Losing at play, 2, 2170; at a law-suit, Pañc. 167, 5.
 3. Defeat, Man. 7, 199.
 4. Conquering, victory, MBh. 1, 5514.
पराजिष्णु पराजिष्णु, i. e. परा-जि + स्नु, adj. Victorious, MBh. 10, 632.

पराञ्च् पराञ्च्, i. e. परा-अञ्च्, adj., f. आची.
 1. Turned away, Bhāg. P. 4, 11, 10.
 2. Distant, 5, 5, 31.
पराधीनता पराधीनता, i. e. पर-अधीन + ता, f. Dependence, Mṛcch. 137, 11.

परापरता परापरता, i. e. पर-अपर + ता, f. and त्व त्व, n.
 1. The condition of being both a genus and a species, Bhāṣāp. 8.
 2. Priority and posteriority, 24.

पराभव पराभव, i. e. परा-भू + अ, m.
 1. Disappearance, Rām. 4, 29, 24.
 2. Defeat, Mārk. P. 18, 28.
 3. Mortification, humiliation, MBh. 4, 464; Pañc. pr. d. 11.
 4. Disregard, Lass. Anth. 43, 9.
पराभाव पराभाव, i. e. परा-भू + अ, m. Defeat, Arj. 10, 45.

पराभूति परा-भू + ति, f.
 1. Defeat, Bhāg. P. 2, 6, 9.
 2. Humiliation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 146.

परामर्श परामर्श, i. e. परा-मृश् + अ, m.
 1. Pulling, MBh. 7, 1399.
 2. Drawing (as a bow), Rām. 1, 76, 17.
 3. Injuring, 3, 7, 30.
 4. Assailing, MBh. 3, 15060.
 5. Consideration, reflexion, MBh. 7, 4188.
 6. Knowledge of the minor premiss in its connection with the major, Bhāṣāp. 67.

परायण परायण, i. e. पर-अयन,
 I. n.
 1. Chief, principal, MBh. 1, 1624.
 2. with कृ, To do one's utmost, 6, 3929.
 II. adj.
 1. Principal, 4, 2269.
 2. Adhering (with accus.), Rām. 1, 7, 9.
 3. Connected with (gen.), MBh. 7, 8252 (leading to victory).
 III. When latter part of a comp. adj. it implies,
 1. Wholly occupied with, Man. 4, 10. []
 2. Intent on, MBh. 3, 2482.
 3. Affected by, Nal. 23, 1.

पारायण पारायण, i. e. पार-अयन, n.
 1. Study, Utt. Rāmac. 34, 10.
 2. Totality, MBh. 13, 2701; Utt. Rāmac. 98, 4.
परायणवन्त् परायण + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Most elevated, MBh. 1, 8055.

परार्ध परार्ध i. e. पर-अर्ध,
 I. m.
 1. The ulterior part, MBh. 2, 1864.
 2. The other part, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 382.
 II. m. and n.
 1. The number 100,000,000,000,000,000.
 2. Fifty years of Brahman (half his supposed æon), Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 33.
 III. (inexactly), instead of परार्ध्य, adj. Most excellent, most beautiful, MBh. 4, 2188.

परार्ध्य परार्ध्य, i. e. परार्ध + य,
 I. adj., f. या, Most excellent, most beautiful, best, MBh. 1, 6962; with abl. More excellent than, Ragh. 10, 65.
 II. n.
 1. An infinite number.
 2. A maximum.
 III. as latter part of comp. adj.
 1. Amounting to an infinite number.
 2. Amounting at the most to.

परावर परावर, i. e. पर-अवर,
 I. adj.
 1. Far and near, MBh. 12, 8336.
 2. Ancestors and descendants, Man. 1, 105.
 3. All-comprising, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 15.
 4. Every succeeding one, Bhāg. P. 3, 5, 36.
 II. n. That which is far and near, i. e.
 1. The universe, MBh. 1, 23.
 2. Totality, Sāv. 6, 34.

पारावार पारावार, i. e. पार-अवार (from अव, being on this side, Gramm. [] ved.)
 1. The opposite bank or shore, and that on this side, MBh. 5, 1017.
 2. m. The sea.
परावरत्व परावर + त्व, n. Condition of being superior or inferior, Bhāg. P. 7, 9, 27.
परावर्तन परावर्तन, i. e. परा-वृत् + अन, n. Turning, MBh. 9, 3193.
परावृज् परावृज्, adj. Humbled, miserable(?), Chr. 296, 8 = Rigv. i. 112, 8.
परावृत्ति परा-वृत् + ति, f. Turning, Hariv. 3138.
पराशर पराशर, m. A proper name.
परासुता परासु + ता, f. and परासुत्वा परासु + त्व, n. Apathy, MBh. 5, 715.

परि परि, and often परी परी (akin to पर),
 I. adv. Round, all round.
 II. prep.
 1. with acc. About, against, to, over.
 2. with abl. From, out, except, after, Man. 3, 119(?); on account, according.
 III. combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives, Round, all round.
 IV. compounded with nouns, Round about, full, quite, excessively.
 --Cf. περί; Lat. per, e. g. in per-idoneus (cf. परा).
पारी पारी, i. e. पॄ + अ + ई, f. A cup, Rājat. 5, 368.
परिकम्पिन् परि-कम्प् + इन्, adj. Trembling violently, Utt. Rāmac. 80, 16.

परिकर परिकर, i. e. परि-कृ + अ, m.
 1. Retinue, dependents, MBh. 10, 274.
 2. Preparation, commencement, Kathās. 26, 200.
 3. Effort, Utt. Rāmac. 125, 2.
 4. Judgment, Rājat. 5, 481.
 5. A girth, Hariv. 3652.
 --Comp.

परिकर्मन् परिकर्मन्, i. e. परि-कृ + मन्,
 I. m. A servant.
 II. n.
 1. Adoration, Bhāg. P. 2, 9, 29.
 2. Personal decoration, dressing, painting, or perfuming the body, Kumāras. 4, 19.
 3. Preparation, Kathās. 22, 101.
परिकर्मय परिकर्मय, a denomin. derived from परिकर्मन् with अय, Par. To adorn, Gīt. 12, 21.
परिकर्मिन् परिकर्मिन्, i. e. परि-कर्मन् + इन्. m. A servant, Suśr. 1, 15, 4.
परिकर्ष परिकर्ष, m. and परिकर्षण [] परिकर्षण, n. i. e. परि-कृष् + अ or अन, Dragging about, MBh. 2, 2615.

पारिपार्श्वक पारिपार्श्व + क,
 1. m. An attendant, MBh. 12, 4339.
 2. f. विका, A chambermaid, Mālav. 47, 8.
पारिपार्श्विक पारिपार्श्विक, i. e. पारि-पार्श्व + इक, m. An attendant, Mālav. 3, 7.
पारिभद्र पारिभद्र, i. e. परि-भद्र + अ, and पारिभद्रक पारि-भद्र + क, m. The coral and other trees.
पारिमाण्डल्य पारिमाण्डल्य, i. e. परिमण्डल + य, adj. Having the measure of an atom, Bhāṣāp. 14.
पारिमाण्य पारिमाण्य, i. e. परि-माण + य, n. Circumference, MBh. 12, 10055.

पारिवित्त्य पारिवित्त्य, i. e. परि-वित्त (vb. विद्), + य, and पारिवेत्त्र्य पारि-वेत्त्र्य, i. e. परिवेत्तृ + य, n. The condition of an elder brother who is unmarried while the younger is married, Yājñ. 3, 235.

पारिषद पारिषद, i. e. परिषद् + अ,
 I. adj. and sbst., Belonging, or one who belongs, to an assembly or council, Nal. 18, 4.
 II. m.
 1. A king's companion, Pañc. 156, 18
 2. pl. The retinue of a god, Rām. 3, 35, 107.
 III. n. Partaking of an assembly, Bhāg. P. 1, 16, 17.
पारिषद्य पारिषद्य, i. e. परिषद् + य, m. One who assists at an assembly, a spectator, Rājat. 5, 465.
पारिहार्य पारिहार्य, i. e. परिहार + य, m. A bracelet, Rājat. 5, 358.
पारिहास्य पारिहास्य, i. e. परिहास + य, n. Jest, Bhāg. P. 6, 2, 14.
पारीन्द्र पारीन्द्र, m. A lion, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1772.

पारुष्य पारुष्य, i. e. परुष + य, n.
 1. Roughness, Suśr. 1, 267, 17 (of the skin).
 2. Squalor, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1472.
 3. Violence, either in word (वाक्पारुष्य, Man. 8, 266), or deed (दण्ड-, 278).
 4. Abuse, contumelious speech, Man. 12, 6.
पारेसिन्धु पारेसिन्धु, i. e. पार + इ-सिन्धु, adv. Beyond the Indus, MBh. 2, 1831.

पारोक्ष्य पारोक्ष्य, i. e. परोक्ष + य,
 I. adj. Invisible, Bhāg. P. 8, 22, 5.
 II. n. A mystery, 4, 28, 65.

पार्थ पार्थ, i. e. पृथा, a proper name, + अ, metronym.
 1. Offspring of Pṛthā, a surname of Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīmasena, and Arjuna.
 2. m. A proper name.
पार्थक्य पार्थक्य, i. e. पृथक् + य, n. Severalty, individuality.
पार्थमय पार्थ + मय, adj. Consisting of descendants of Pṛthā, MBh. 8, 4847.
पार्थव पार्थव, i. e. पृथु + अ, adj., f. वी, Belonging to Pṛthu, Bhāg. P. 1, 3, 14.

पार्थिव पार्थिव, i. e. पृथिवी + अ,
 I. adj., f. वी.
 1. Terrestrial, Chr. 290, 3 [] = Rigv. i. 64, 3 (वा for वानि).
 2. Ruling or possessing the earth, Chr. 14, 17.
 3. Royal, fit for kings or princes, MBh. 5, 2187.
 II. m.
 1. An inhabitant of the earth, Rām. 2, 25, 20.
 2. A king, a prince.
 III. f. वी, Sītā.
पार्थिवता पार्थिव + ता, f., and पार्थिवत्व पार्थिव + त्व, n. Royal dignity, MBh. 2, 1007; 1051.
पार्वतेय पार्वतेय, i. e. पर्वत + एय, m. A certain prince ruling in the mountains, MBh. 1, 2666.
पार्वायनान्तीय पार्वायनान्तीय, i. e. पर्वन्-अयन-अन्त + इय, adj. Occurring at the end of a Parvan (i. e. a half of the lunar month), or a solstice, Man. 4, 10 (Lois. पार्वायणान्त्˚).

पार्श्व पार्श्व, i. e. पर्शु (ved. a rib), + अ, n. and m.
 1. The part of the body below the armpit.
 2. A side, MBh. 13, 2749.
 3. = पार्ष्णि
 3. q. cf.
 4. Proximity.
 5. वे, loc. Near, Śāk. d. 9.
 6. वम्, acc. Near to, Rājat. 5, 467.
पार्श्वक पार्श्व + क, m. A rib, Yājñ. 3, 89.

पार्श्वग पार्श्व-ग, adj. An attendant, Rājat. 5, 56.
 --Comp.
पार्श्वतस् पार्श्व + तस्, adv. By or from the side of, Chr. 35, 11.
पार्श्वद पार्श्व-द, m. An attendant, MBh. 9, 2546.
पार्श्वस्थ पार्श्व-स्थ, adj. Staying near or at the side, Rām. 3, 40, 21.

पार्षत पार्षत, i. e. पृषत + अ.
 I. patronym. f. ती, A descendant of Pṛṣata, i. e. Drupada, Johns. Sel. 27, 20
 II. adj. Of, or belonging to, the spotted deer, Man. 3, 269.

पार्षद पार्षद, i. e. पर्षद् + अ, m.
 1. An attendant.
 2. Retinue, Hariv. 7252.

पार्ष्णि पार्ष्णि, m. and f., and पार्ष्णी पार्ष्णी (Pañc. 200, 3), f.
 1. The heel, MBh. 7, 3179.
 2. The rear of an army, the back, Ragh. 4, 26.
 3. The extremities of the axletree to which are fastened the two outer horses of a carriage drawn by four horses in one line, MBh. 4, 1415.
 --Cf. Goth. fairzna; O.H.G. fersna; A.S. fiersna; Lat. compernes, pernix; πτέρνα.
परि- + पिञ्जर परि- + पिञ्जर, adj. brown-red, Kām. Nītis. 13, 14.
पर- + पुरंजय पर- + पुरंजय, adj. conquering the enemy's towns, Nal. 20, 1.
पर- + पूर्वा पर- + पूर्व, f. a woman formerly married, having belonged formerly to another man, Chr. 6, 8.

परि- + पेलव परि- + पेलव,
 I. adj. 1. very small. 2. very delicate.
 II. n. a fragrant grass, Cyperus rotundus.
परतस्- + पोष परतस्- + पोष, adj. nourished by another, 3, 33, 28.
परि-दुस्- + बल परि-दुस्- + बल, adj. very weak, Rām. 3, 63, 5.
पर-लोक- + बाध पर-लोक- + बाध, f. loss of paradise, Pañc. 167, 8 (cf. my transl.).
पर- + भाग पर- + भाग, m. 1. supremacy, Pañc. i. d. 375. 2. highest degree, Kathās. 1, 47 (cf. दिव्य-मानुष).
पर- + भाग्य पर- + भाग्य n. another's property, Hit. i. d. 24, M.M.
परिचित- + भू परिचित- + भू, adj. of which the places are known, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 11.
पर- + भूषण पर- + भूषण, adj., Hit. iv. d. 121; false reading for परि-, q. cf. मङ्गल-मात्र-, adj., f. णा, only adorned with turmeric, Vikr. d. 53.

पराङ्-मुख पराङ्-मुख, i. e. पराङ्च्-,
 I. adj., f. खी. 1. having the face averted, Pañc. 181, 15. 2. averse, Pañc. i. d. 405; disinclined, Vikr. d. 102 (प्रवृत्ति-, to give a report). 3. regardless, Mārk. P. 22, 44.
 II. m. a spell or charm spoken over weapons, Rām. 1, 31, 5 Gorr.
परि-वृत्त-अर्ध- + मुख परि-वृत्त-अर्ध- + मुख, [] adj., f. खी, having turned half her face, Vikr. d. 17.

पर- + आयत्त पर- + आयत्त, adj. 1. depending on another, Pañc. i. d. 295, v. r.
 2. ruled, Kathās. 18, 381.
पर- + रमण पर- + रमण, m. a paramour, Pañc. i. d. 196.
परशु- + राम परशु- + राम, m. the first of the three renowned Rāmas, the son of Jamadagni, Prab. 5, 5 (cf. Chr. 16, 17).
परि- + लघु परि- + लघु, adj. 1. very small, Utt. Rāmac. 107, 9. 2. very pure, Megh. 13. 3. very indifferent, Utt. Rāmac. 100, 4.
पर- + लोक पर- + लोक, m. heaven, paradise, Pañc. 207, 21.
परशु- + वन परशु- + वन, n. the name of a hell, MBh. 12, 12075.
पर्ववर्ज + म् पर्ववर्ज + म्, i. e. पर्वन्-, adj. except the forbidden days of the month, Man. 3, 45.
पार्श्व- + वर्तिन् पार्श्व- + वर्तिन्, adj. being at the side, Ragh. 19, 4.
पर- + वश पर- + वश, adj. depending on another, Hit. i. d. 201, M.M.
परिभव- + विधि परिभव- + विधि, m. humiliation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1233.
पार्श्व- + विवर्तिन् पार्श्व- + विवर्तिन्, adj. living at the side, Kathās. 19, 101.
परि- + विह्वल परि- + विह्वल, adj. very agitated, Rām. 2, 84, 6 Gorr.
पर-अधीन- + वृत्ति पर-अधीन- + वृत्ति, adj. dependent on another, Megh. 8.

परोक्ष- + वृत्ति परोक्ष- + वृत्ति,
 I. f. unseen, unwitnessed behaviour, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 610.
 II. adj. one whose behaviour is not witnessed by anybody, ib.
परि- + वेद परि- + वेद, m. complete knowledge, MBh. 3, 13462.
परःशत परःशत, i. e. परस्-, adj., f. ता, more than a hundred, MBh. 6, 4267.
परिणत-शरद् परिणत-शरद्, i. e. परि-नत- (vb. नम्), f. the latter part of autumn, Megh. 109.
पर्ण- + शाला पर्ण- + शाला, f. 1. an arbour, Rām. 3, 6, 15. 2. the name of a district inhabited by anchorites, MBh. 13, 3398.
परि- + शाश्वत परि- + शाश्वत, adj. eternal, MBh. 5, 4574.
पर- + शासन पर- + शासन, n. the order of another, Pañc. i. d. 300 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3292).
परि- + शुश्रूषा परि- + शुश्रूषा, f. complete obedience, Lass. 41, 15.
परि- + शून्य परि- + शून्य, adj. completely empty, or void of, Ragh. 8, 65; 19, 6.
परि- + शोष परि- + शोष, m. complete drying up or shrivelling, Rām. 4, 15, 34.
पारेश्मशानम् पारेश्मशानम्, i. e. पार + इ-श्मशान + म्, adv. beyond the cemetery, Mālat. 79, 19.
पर- + श्रित पर- + श्रित, adj. dependent, Hit. ii. d. 20.
परश्वस् परश्वस्, incorrectly for परःश्वस्, i. e. परस्-, adv. The day after to-morrow, Pañc. ed. orn. 41, 10.
परि- + षोडश परि- + षोडश, full sixteen, Nal. 26, 2.
परि- + संवत्सर परि- + संवत्सर, m. a full year, Man. 3, 119.
पर्वसंधि पर्वसंधि, i. e. पर्वन्-, m. the time of the periodic change of the moon, MBh. 3, 11647.
परि- + समुत्सुक परि- + समुत्सुक, adj. very agitated, Rām. 2, 65, 11.
परःसहस्र परःसहस्र, i. e. परस्-, adj., f. रा, more than a thousand, Utt. Rāmac. 11, 8.
पार्ष्णि- + सारथि पार्ष्णि- + सारथि, m. du. the two carioteers who govern the outer horses attached to the extremities of the axletree, MBh. 1, 5490.
पर- + स्व पर- + स्व, n. another person's property, Man. 7, 123.
पर- + हंस पर- + हंस, and परम-, m. an ascetic who has subdued all his senses, MBh. 13, 6478 (परम).
